properties: Six complete JobCreateRequest payloads are reconstructed from the content-addressed source registry and validated against the frozen manifest before hashing.
Each Job contains one preregistered scenario, ten CRN seeds, real_cli, optimizer_strategy=none, zero provider turns/requests/retries, and no provider credentials.
The bundle binds source, manifest, trial plan, composite inventory, JobCreateRequest schema, six deterministic idempotency keys, six request hashes, and all sixty planned Trial input/effect hashes.
A checkpoint store must durably persist dispatch_attempted before the injected transport may issue one create call.
A checkpoint failure prevents I/O; a crash after durable dispatch but before Job observation requires manual read-only reconciliation and cannot automatically replay POST.

Terminal observations bind actual Job/Trial IDs to planned ordinal, seed, scenario type, fixed baseline candidate, input contract, effect request, required effect readbacks, parameter readback, telemetry, metrics, artifact inventory, and artifact content hashes.
Failed, timeout, cancelled, and indeterminate work remains in the ten-Trial denominator and cannot be overwritten by a completed claim.
